claims.quote: RS is caused by mutations in the X-linked methyl CpG-binding protein 2 (MECP2) gene.
MECP2 mutations are now frequently identified in mentally retarded male patients.

claims.object_text: frequency of disease-causing MECP2 mutations in this population is between 1.3% and 1.7%
claims.quote: The frequency of disease-causing MECP2 mutations in this population is between 1.3% and 1.7%.
Surprisingly, MECP2 mutations in males are responsible for a wide spectrum of neurological disorders, ranging from mild mental retardation to severe neonatal encephalopathy.
